task.title: Preparing to license without an Internet connection
task.shortdesc: The controller license is required during commissioning. Typically, the license file for the controller already resides on the licensing server, where (if you have Internet connectivity) the Commissioning Wizard automatically retrieves it during the licensing step. If your PC will not have Internet connectivity when you are commissioning the nc, you can still install the controller license during commissioning.

taskbody.prereq: A license for the controller (.lar file) was emailed to you.

step.cmd: To make the file available to , copy the file to your !security/licenses/inbox folder
